_comment: Feature extraction settings (SRS Step 6, FR xx), shared by training and the web app. Changing them requires re-running 'python -m sonic.features build' and retraining.
_frames: 512-sample (32 ms) frames every 256 samples (16 ms) at 16 kHz: about 63 frames per 1 s segment.
_mel: 64 mel bands from 20 Hz to 8 kHz (the 16 kHz Nyquist limit). The log-mel spectrogram is the CNN input.
_summary: For the classical models each frame-level feature is summarised over the segment (mean, standard deviation, and max where it helps). The 64 mel bands are averaged into 16 coarse bands.
_tempo: Tempo is not extracted: a 1 s segment holds at most one or two beats, so a tempo estimate would be noise. The SRS asks for tempo 'where relevant'.
